messages:
nora: Heads-up: console shows a weird p99 jump for /v1/chat in APAC during the staged rollout. p50 stable, p99 spikes, sample_count for the minute bucket was 11. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/rollout-apac-p99
ayana: low-sample territory. Curious whether this is a quantization/fallback artifact or a real tail shift. Do we have the raw samples?
kevin: grabbed them from the telemetry store:
```
window: 2026-04-05T09:20Z
endpoint: /v1/chat
region: ap-southeast-1
sample_count: 11
latencies_ms: [18,20,21,22,23,24,25,28,290,305,320]
```
kevin: tdigest_p99=320, empirical_p99=320
sre-marc: classic small-n dominated by a few outliers. Two quick paths: (A) treat p99 as "empirical peak" for n<12, with an explicit provenance label; (B) show a CI around p99 instead of a scalar. Both need UX work.
product-anya: Users assume the percentile is a single truth. Proposal: show three things inline when n<200: (1) percentile value, (2) a tiny ascii spark/hist with markers, (3) a provenance chip like "empirical" or "tdigest" plus confidence (low/med/high). Example: p99: 320ms [▁▁▁▁▂▁▁▁▁▃] provenance: empirical (low)
ayana: +1 on provenance. Also add a hover tooltip that explains tie-breaker rules (how we compute p99 when we have sketches vs raw).
neora: small correction: provenance label should be "sampled-empirical" vs "sketch-approx" to avoid confusion.
kevin: implementation note: telemetry already stores sketch metadata: q_samples, raw_count, hist_fallback_flag. We can expose a compact provenance string: e.g., "sketch:tdigest:qs=9" or "empirical:raw=11" and render friendly text in UI.
sre-marc: For alerts: gate p99 SLOs when raw_count < 30 OR when provenance indicates histogram fallback with coarse buckets. Alert engine should prefer median-based SLOs on endpoints with <200 qps.
product-anya: UX language: show "Percentile confidence: Low (n=11)" next to the number and make the tiny histogram clickable to expand raw-sample view + summary stats (min/median/max/std).
ora: command I used to pull samples for audit:
```
# fetch raw samples
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/query?e=/v1/chat&r=ap-southeast-1&from=2026-04-05T09:10Z&to=2026-04-05T09:25Z" | jq .samples
```
kevin: Dev note: fetching raw samples in the UI must be lazy and cached; otherwise we'll blow up payloads for dashboards. Add a cheap checksum so UI can detect if already fetched.
ayana: let's also add a lightweight approximate CI for p99 for n<50 using order-statistics bounds (no bootstrap) so users see an error band without heavy compute.
sre-marc: agreed. I'll update the alert rules and silence the false-positive for this rollout.
devex-bot: action created: ENG-PLAT-1602 "Percentile provenance + confidence UX" assigned to kevin + ayana, due 2026-04-12.
product-anya: I'll draft the small copy and a tooltip spec. We should include recommended SLO advice: prefer median or error-rate SLOs for low-volume endpoints and document how regional failovers can sparsify buckets.
ora: thanks all. Annotating the rollout notes to mark this as sampling-noise and closing the noisy alert.
kevin: will spike an initial UI prototype next week and post designs in #eng-platform.
ayana: will prototype the order-stat bounds for p99 and run perf checks.
ora: :thumbsup:
